title: Midnight Violet Loaded Water (HQ)
notes: Replica of the drink-recipe Short. No real product was given for this video: the store-brand sparkling water bottle of the original is an unbranded "Concord Grape" bottle (no brand name or logo), and the tumbler, ice spheres, glitter jar, glass straw and bamboo lid are generic. Same bright white kitchen. Sora audio stands in for the original sound. Each camera setup is one Sora take (2 takes) cut into the original's jump cuts. HQ version: keyframes drawn at native 9:16 (1152x2048) and downscaled to Sora's 720x1280 (sora-2 renders no larger), final encode crf 14 slow with light sharpening.
style: Bright, airy vertical phone video in a modern white kitchen in soft daylight: a white marble counter with soft grey veins, white shaker cabinets, a white range hood, a grey herringbone tile backsplash, gold and black accents. Clean, crisp, saturated purple drink. Hands in a periwinkle blue-lavender ribbed-knit sweater with long white manicured nails. ASMR drink-making close-ups, steady camera. No on-screen text, no logos. Shot in 4K detail: tack-sharp focus, crisp condensation and bubbles, glossy ice.

tumbler.desc: a big 40 oz clear glass travel tumbler: a tall wide straight-sided cylindrical body that steps in to a narrower cylindrical bottom section (to fit a cup holder), flat bottom, NO stem and NO foot, thick clear glass, a big clear glass C-shaped handle on the right, no logo

iceballs.desc: smooth glossy round ice balls about 3 cm across frozen from purple grape juice: translucent jewel-like violet to deep purple spheres you can partly see through, perfectly round, no stems (they are ice, not grapes)

container.desc: a clear rectangular plastic food storage container with rounded corners

bottle.desc: a 1-litre clear plastic sparkling water bottle with a white screw cap and a purple wraparound label with a bunch of grapes and the words "Concord Grape" in white, no brand name or logo

glitter.desc: a small round clear jar with a black screw lid, filled with shimmering purple edible drink glitter

straw.desc: a long clear glass drinking straw

lid.desc: a round natural bamboo tumbler lid with a straw hole
